```{r}
#rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

```
  The RNA-seq data contains 2 conditions: BT549-Ctrl, BT549-TGFb (10ng/mL for 24hr). With 3 repliates each.
  First, RNA-seq reads were quantified using Salmon/1.8.0. 
  Transcriptome version: GRCh38, Ensembl 111

1. We will import count files using tximport.
```{r}
# Load metadata and tx2gene file
dir <- "/Users/xiaohanning/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Xiaohan/BT549_4T1_TGFb_bulk_rnaseq"
meta_BT549 <- read.table(file.path(dir,"Analysis/BT549_TGFb_metadata.csv"), sep=",",header=T)
meta_BT549$Condition <- factor(meta_BT549$Condition)
meta_BT549$Genotype <- factor(meta_BT549$Genotype)
txdb_Homo <- makeTxDbFromEnsembl(organism="Homo sapiens", release=111)
k_Homo <- keys(txdb_Homo, keytype="TXNAME")
tx2gene_Homo <- select(txdb_Homo, k_Homo, "GENEID", "TXNAME")
# Load Salmon output using tximport
files_BT549 <- file.path(dir,paste("Salmon/results/salmon_Homo/",meta_BT549$Sample,"_salmon", sep=""),"quant.sf")
names(files_BT549)<-meta_BT549$Sample
txi_data_BT549 <- tximport(files_BT549, type="salmon",tx2gene=tx2gene_Homo, ignoreTxVersion = T)
write.table(txi_data_BT549$counts, file = file.path(dir, "Analysis/gene_counts_BT549.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```


2. Make DEseq dataset
```{r}
names(txi_data_BT549)
head(txi_data_BT549$counts)
dds_BT549 <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi_data_BT549, colData = meta_BT549, design = ~Condition)
colnames(dds_BT549) <- meta_BT549$Sample
dds_BT549
```

```{r}
# Data QC, remove genes with low counts
keep_BT549 <- rowSums(counts(dds_BT549)) >= 10
dds_BT549 <- dds_BT549[keep_BT549,]
```

```{r}
# Run DESeq
dds_BT549 <- DESeq(dds_BT549) 
resultsNames(dds_BT549) 
```

```{r}
dds_BT549 <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "Analysis/BT549_TGFb_deseq2.rds"))
res_BT549 <- results(dds_BT549, contrast=c("Condition","TGFb","Ctrl")) #TGFb vs Ctrl
#saveRDS(dds_BT549, file.path(dir, "Analysis/BT549_TGFb_deseq2.rds"))
```

```{r}
# LFCshrink

resLFC_BT549
plotMA(res_BT549, ylim=c(-3,3))
plotMA(resLFC_BT549, ylim=c(-3,3))
```

```{r}
# RNA
genenames_human <- select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys= keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype="ENSEMBL"), columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
resfile_BT549 <- res_BT549
filename_BT549 <- "BT549_TGFb_vs_Ctrl.deseq2_output.tsv"
plotname_BT549 <- "BT549-TGFb vs BT549-Ctrl"

  resp_table_BT549 <- merge(as.data.frame(resfile_BT549), genenames_human, by.x=0, by.y="ENSEMBL")
  resp_table_BT549 <- resp_table_BT549[!duplicated(resp_table_BT549$SYMBOL),]
  resp_table_BT549 <- resp_table_BT549 %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
  resp_table_BT549 <- resp_table_BT549[order(resp_table_BT549$padj), ]
  Volcano_BT549 <- EnhancedVolcano(resp_table_BT549, lab=rownames(resp_table_BT549), x="log2FoldChange", y="padj", title= plotname_BT549, xlim = c(-8,8), ylim=c(0,120), pointSize = 1, pCutoff=10e-5, FCcutoff=1, labSize=4) # One or more p-values is 0. Converting to 10^-1 * current lowest non-zero p-value
  print(Volcano_BT549)
  
  write.table(resp_table_BT549, file=file.path(dir,"DEseq2",filename_BT549), sep='\t', row.names=T)
  resSig_BT549 <- subset(resp_table_BT549, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5)
  resSig_BT549 <- resSig_BT549[order(-resSig_BT549$log2FoldChange),] # Descending
  print(str(sum(resSig_BT549$log2FoldChange > 0)), str(sum(resSig_BT549$log2FoldChange < 0)))
  write.table(resSig_BT549, file=paste(dir, "/DEseq2/",plotname_BT549,".deseq2_significant.tsv",sep=""), sep='\t', row.names=T)
```

3. Prepare dataset for GSEA   
```{r}
norm_counts_BT549 <- as.data.frame(counts(dds_BT549, normalized=T))
norm_counts_BT549 <- cbind(DESCRIPTION = "na", norm_counts_BT549)
write.table(norm_counts_BT549, file=file.path(dir, "GSEA/norm_counts_BT549.txt"), sep="\t")
# norm_counts_BT549 <- read.table("/Users/xiaohanning/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Xiaohan/BT549_4T1_TGFb_bulk_rnaseq/GSEA/norm_counts_BT549.txt")
genenames_human <- select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys= keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype="ENSEMBL"), columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
norm_genes_BT549 <- merge(as.data.frame(norm_counts_BT549), genenames_human, by.x=0, by.y="ENSEMBL")
norm_genes_BT549 <- norm_genes_BT549[!duplicated(norm_genes_BT549$SYMBOL),]
norm_genes_BT549 <- norm_genes_BT549 %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
norm_genes_BT549 <- norm_genes_BT549[, -1] # remove Ensembl column
write.table(norm_genes_BT549, file=file.path(dir, "GSEA/norm_genes_BT549.txt"), sep="\t")
```

4. Retrieve glycosylation-related genes
```{r}
# Install if not already installed
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("clusterProfiler")
BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db")  # For human gene annotation
BiocManager::install("KEGGREST")      # For accessing KEGG pathway information
install.packages("biomaRt")

# Load the required packages
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)  # Replace with appropriate organism database if needed
library(KEGGREST)
library(biomaRt)


# Connect to Ensembl BioMart
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# Retrieve all GO terms with descriptions
go_terms <- getBM(attributes = c("go_id", "name_1006"), mart = ensembl)

# Filter GO terms related to glycosylation
glycosylation_terms <- go_terms[grep("glycosylation", go_terms$name_1006, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
print(glycosylation_terms)

# Define glycosylation-related GO terms
go_glycosylation_terms <- c("GO:0070085",  # glycosylation
                            "GO:0006486",  # protein glycosylation
                            "GO:0006487",  # protein N-linked glycosylation
                            "GO:0016757",  # Glycosyltransferase activity
                            "GO:0008373")  # Sialyltransferase activity
                            
                            
# Retrieve genes associated with these GO terms
go_gene_list <- bitr(go_glycosylation_terms, fromType="GO", toType="SYMBOL", OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db")
go_genes <- unique(go_gene_list$SYMBOL)

# Define the KEGG pathway ID for N-Glycan biosynthesis
kegg_pathway <- "hsa00510"

# Retrieve pathway information using KEGGREST
pathway_info <- keggGet(kegg_pathway)

# Extract gene information from the pathway
genes_info <- pathway_info[[1]]$GENE

# Extract the gene symbols from the gene information
# The GENE information is usually in pairs, with the gene ID and gene symbol
kegg_genes <- genes_info[seq(2, length(genes_info), by = 2)]
# Remove full name; only keep short gene symbols in front of ";".
kegg_genes <- sub(";.*", "", genes_info[seq(2, length(genes_info), by = 2)])

# View the first few gene symbols
head(kegg_genes)


# Combine the gene lists
Human_Glycan_genes <- unique(c(go_genes, kegg_genes))

# Display the combined list of genes
head(Human_Glycan_genes)

#write.table(Human_Glycan_genes, file = paste0(dir, "/Glycosylation/Human_Glycan_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

```

5. Virtualize glycosylation-related genes
```{r}
Human_Glycan_genes <- read.table(file.path(dir,"Glycosylation/Human_Glycan_genes.csv"), sep=",",header=T)

# Step 1: Convert csv into character
Human_Glycan_genes <- as.character(Human_Glycan_genes)

# Step 2: Clean up the string by removing unwanted characters
Human_Glycan_genes <- gsub("c\\(|\\)", "", Human_Glycan_genes)

# Step 3: Split the string into a vector
Human_Glycan_genes <- unlist(strsplit(Human_Glycan_genes, split = ",\\s*"))

# Step 4: Remove any remaining quotes
Human_Glycan_genes <- gsub("\"", "", Human_Glycan_genes)

# Now `gene_vector` is a clean character vector of gene names
print(Human_Glycan_genes)

# Label glyco-related genes in Volcano plot
Volcano_BT549_glyco <- EnhancedVolcano(resp_table_BT549, lab=rownames(resp_table_BT549), x="log2FoldChange", y="padj", selectLab = Human_Glycan_genes, drawConnectors = T,max.overlaps = 50,title= plotname_BT549, xlim = c(-8,8), ylim=c(0,120), pointSize = 1, pCutoff=10e-5, FCcutoff=0.25, labSize=4)  # One or more p-values is 0. Converting to 10^-1 * current lowest non-zero p-value
  print(Volcano_BT549_glyco)
  

# Retrieve glyco-related DGE (padj < 0.05)
BT549_Glycan_genes <- subset(resp_table_BT549, rownames(resp_table_BT549) %in% Human_Glycan_genes & padj < 0.05)
BT549_Glycan_genes <- BT549_Glycan_genes[order(BT549_Glycan_genes$log2FoldChange,decreasing = T),]
write.table(BT549_Glycan_genes, file=paste(dir, "/Glycosylation/BT549_sig_Glycan_genes.tsv",sep=""), sep='\t', row.names=T)

# Extract the log2 fold changes
lfc_BT549_Glycan_genes <- as.matrix(BT549_Glycan_genes$log2FoldChange)

# Ensure row names (gene names) are preserved
rownames(lfc_BT549_Glycan_genes) <- rownames(BT549_Glycan_genes)

# Plot the heatmap
pheatmap(lfc_BT549_Glycan_genes,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Set to TRUE if you have multiple conditions (columns)
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,  # Set to TRUE if you have multiple conditions (columns)
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
         main = "Glycosylation-related gene: BT549_TGFβ vs BT549_Ctrl")

```

```{r}
# Read DESeq2 CSV
resp_table_BT549 <- read.table("/Users/xiaohanning/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Xiaohan/BT549_4T1_TGFb_bulk_rnaseq/DEseq2/BT549_TGFb_vs_Ctrl.deseq2_output.tsv",sep="\t")

# Label glyco-related genes in Volcano plot
sig_BT549_genes <- rownames(BT549_Glycan_genes)
top10 <- sig_BT549_genes[c(1:10)]
bottom10 <- sig_BT549_genes[(length(sig_BT549_genes)-9):length(sig_BT549_genes)]
colored <- which(rownames(resp_table_BT549) %in% c(top10,bottom10))
notcolored <- setdiff(1:nrow(resp_table_BT549),colored)
resp_ordered <- resp_table_BT549[c(notcolored,colored),]

keyvals.colour <- ifelse(rownames(resp_ordered) %in% top10, 'red',ifelse(rownames(resp_ordered) %in% bottom10,"blue",'grey'))
keyvals.colour[is.na(keyvals.colour)] <- "grey"
names(keyvals.colour)[keyvals.colour == "red"] <- 'Up'
names(keyvals.colour)[keyvals.colour == "blue"] <- 'Down'
names(keyvals.colour)[keyvals.colour == "grey"] <- 'All'
Volcano_BT549_glyco <- EnhancedVolcano(resp_ordered, lab=rownames(resp_ordered), x="log2FoldChange", y="padj",colCustom = keyvals.colour, selectLab = c(top10, bottom10), drawConnectors = T,max.overlaps = 50,title= plotname_BT549, xlim = c(-8,8), ylim=c(0,150), pointSize = 2, pCutoff=10e-5, FCcutoff=0.25, colConnectors = "grey50",labSize=4)  # One or more p-values is 0. Converting to 10^-1 * current lowest non-zero p-value
  print(Volcano_BT549_glyco)
```
